body:
Hey, we found where the issue is. The error happens because we build our files in ES5, not in ES3.

Steps you need to take to transform our code into ES3:

1. install babel
2. add the plugins: `'babel-plugin-transform-es3-property-literals', 'babel-plugin-transform-es3-member-expression-literals', '@babel/plugin-transform-reserved-words',`
3. run babel on InstantSearch

Then only after that, YUI compressor will be happy and work.
